title: TAR-0520 gel in EGFR inhibitor-induced folliculitis
official: A phase 2a multicentric study of TAR-0520 gel in EGFR inhibitor-induced folliculitis
summary: Main objective: To confirm the good local tolerance of TAR-0520 gel applied to the face and chest of colorectal cancer patients treated with anti-EGFR antibodies

interventions.name: TAR-0520 gel matching vehicle without active ingredients

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female, who is at least 18 years of age or older at screening visit
2. Clinical diagnosis of metastatic colorectal carcinoma planned to be treated with cetuximab or panitumumab injections as part of the chemotherapy protocol
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient with a medical history of EGFRi treatment in the past two years
2. Patient has a history of other skin disorders (eg, atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, recurrent skin infections), or history of illness that, in the opinion of the Investigator, would confound results of the study
